title: The Jordan River
lead: The river that runs from Mount Hermon through the Sea of Galilee to the Dead Sea, Israel's eastern border. Israel crossed it into the land under Joshua, Elijah and Elisha parted it, and John baptized Jesus in it (Joshua 3–4; 2 Kings 2; Mark 1:9).

sections.b: Lot chose the well-watered "whole Plain of the Jordan" (Genesis 13:10). The land promised to Abraham's family lay west of it (Numbers 34:12), so the eastern tribes needed special terms (Numbers 32; Joshua 22). Israel crossed it on dry ground (Joshua 3–4), and Elijah and Elisha parted it again (2 Kings 2:8, 14). Naaman was healed by washing in it seven times (2 Kings 5:14). John the Baptist baptized in it, and Jesus was baptized there (Mark 1:5, 9). In later Christian hymns and African American spirituals, "crossing Jordan" became a picture of death and entry into heaven.
